'''2006 World Championship 6 V-Card Tournament David Destefanis LS Local Uprising''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David Destefanis]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (6 V-Card Tournament); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Michael "mc9457" Carr (2006-11-08).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35794 David Destefanis' 6 V-Card Deck - Local Uprising]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071213225204/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35794 Internet Archive]</ref>
